name: Pillar
text: Cannot be entered. Blocks line of sight. Cannot be damaged.

name: Rubble
text: A non-flying slide that enters Rubble stops there.

name: Votive Shrine
text: A Wickfolk piece on or adjacent may spend its Strike to light it. A Lit Shrine heals 1 HP to each Wickfolk piece on or adjacent to it at Tally. A Snuff ending a move on it, or a Snuff attack covering it, puts it out. In Last Flame, lighting one gives +1 Glory.

name: Chimney
text: Comes in pairs. A voluntary Move by a Wickfolk piece that enters a Chimney ends on the paired Chimney, if that one is empty. No chaining. For everything else it is a flagstone.

name: Hot Wax
text: 1 damage to a non-flying, non-immune piece that ends any movement on it, and 1 more at each Tally while it stays. Sliding through does nothing.
